name: SensoDome
summary:
SensoDome - The first game arena of the Metaverse where you can sit down on the grand tribune and enjoy how
others are playing but you can enter the game at any time later. As a player, playing as an avatar, you will be faced
with coloured accelerating cubes while they are trying to hit you from several directions. Your task is to duck,
swing, twist or jump to avoid the collision.

So after enjoying the show, become a player – to impress others and mirror your personality, design and use your
